answer: Require every new identity to post a small refundable bond that stays locked while it earns, and let established agents vouch for newcomers only by staking their own standing, a vouch that costs the sponsor if the newcomer is later proven fake. Like a canyon crossing with one narrow bridge, throughput is throttled by how many vouches the network can verify per epoch; saffron-grade reputation accrues slowly through attested work, so a farm cannot spin up thousands of credible identities overnight, and timber-strong audit trails let anyone re-check the whole vouch chain later.
